title: Nether beds in Overworld
description: This datapack adds the bed behavior from Nether to Overworld. Similarly, respawn anchors have the same behavior. Use this to wreak havoc! :)
body:
This datapack adds the bed behavior from Nether to Overworld. Similarly, respawn anchors have the same behavior (They don't explode in Overwold). Use this to wreak havoc! :)
